# A baseline of its own

A number goal’s baseline can be a figure already known for a period, often provisional: shown as its number until the first check-in, and firmed up without a plan change.

## The rule

**Data.** A number goal (`kind: 'metric'`) may carry `baseline: { value, period, provisional }`: the figure, the period it covers in words (“June to September 2026”, at most 60 characters) and whether it may still be firmed up. Stored in three nullable columns, all null when there is none; a period or the flag never goes without the figure.

**Rule 1. When a goal has one** (`baselineOf`). When its period is given: the figure is the plan's start (Baseline in the form, Start on the Goals sheet, `start` in the tools). No period, no baseline of its own; “none” on the sheet or in the tools removes it. The flag is “provisional” or “firm” (firm when not said).

**Rule 2. Shown until the first check-in** (`baselineShown`, `nowText`). Before the goal's first check-in its number is the baseline: “41.5 min (baseline)” in every list, and on its page the number with “Baseline, June to September 2026, provisional” beside it, then the target. It is not a check-in: the status (No check-in yet, or Not started in week 0), the trend, the projection and what is due are worked out exactly as before. From the first check-in on, the check-in's number is shown and the baseline is not.

**Rule 3. Firming it up isn't a plan change** (`startsFromProvisional`, `planChanged`). While the plan starts from a provisional baseline (its figure is the plan's start), moving that start, and nothing else in the plan, is not a plan change: no reason is asked once check-ins have started, and the plan before isn't kept. Unticking Provisional is never a plan change. A firm baseline's start moves as any start does, and a baseline is marked provisional only before the goal's first check-in, so a goal with check-ins can't be made provisional to move its start unasked. A goal carried into next year from its final number leaves last year's baseline behind.

**Must fix.** A period over 60 characters: “The baseline’s period can be at most 60 characters.”, at the Baseline (Start) field. Provisional ticked on a firm baseline, or a new one, once the goal has check-ins: “A baseline can be marked provisional only before the goal’s first check-in. To move where the plan starts now, change Start and say why.”, at the same field. A word Baseline is doesn't know: an unknown word, as every word column says.

## Worked examples

Each is run against the real rule by `src/spec/spec.test.ts`: the result is what the code gives.

| Given | The rule gives |
|---|---|
| Merge-to-deploy time (lead-merge) with a provisional baseline of its plan’s start for June to September 2026, before any check-in. | `Baseline, June to September 2026, provisional` |
| The same goal, its number in a list before the first check-in. | `ends “(baseline)”` |
| Its start moved by 1 while the baseline is provisional. | `not a plan change` |
| The same move with a firm baseline. | `a plan change` |
| Start 12 with no period given. | `no baseline` |

## Not self-explanatory

- **Not self-explanatory:** A range goal has no start, so no baseline of its own yet.
- **Not self-explanatory:** A goal with a baseline and no target or date (backlog GB) builds on this: there the baseline is the number and nothing is judged until a target is set; it also lets a goal measured by a metric with a gap (MS) go in without a made-up start.

## Requirements

- `GOAL-BASELINE`: A baseline can be a figure of its own (BL). A number goal's Baseline can say the period it covers ("June to September 2026", at most 60 characters) and whether it is provisional, in New goal, Change a goal, the Goals sheet (Baseline period, Baseline is) and the tools (baseline_period, baseline_is). Until the goal's first check-in, it is shown as the goal's number, marked as the baseline: "41.5 min (baseline)" in lists, and the number with "Baseline, {period}, provisional" on its page; its status is worked out as before. Firming up a provisional baseline, moving the start it is, is not a plan change: it asks for no reason and keeps no earlier plan.
